verdict.rationale: Veo's docs say it turns images into short videos and accepts text, image, audio and video inputs together, with character consistency and multi-turn editing. That covers reference-driven generation. However, nothing explicitly documents style transfer, meaning generating new footage in a reference's style. One hands-on report (in Whisk) says image-sourced generation redraws the source so heavily it barely resembles the original, which raises doubt about fidelity to the reference but does not directly contradict a style-reference claim. Missing for 10: explicit documented style-reference/style-transfer capability, documented video-as-style-reference workflow, independent corroboration of output matching the reference's style.
